Class ImaMedia3AdPlayer

java.lang.Object
com.appscend.media.events.ima.ImaMedia3AdPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.api.player.AdProgressProvider, com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.api.player.VideoAdPlayer, com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.api.player.VolumeProvider
public final class ImaMedia3AdPlayer extends Object implements com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3.api.player.VideoAdPlayer
IMA's VideoAdPlayer: one Media3 player per break plays its preloaded ads as a playlist keyed by AdMediaInfo, into a media-overlay SurfaceView.
